events.what: Roy and Hariharasubramanian give a forbidden-induced-subgraph characterisation of word-representable near-triangulations

judgement.doubts: Near-triangulations are a proper subclass of planar graphs, so this is a case, not the whole bullet. The preprint has not been reviewed; the paper says it corrects errors in earlier work, so a later reader should watch for responses. The Pith Review page was never opened and does not count as verification either way.
